# ProfileFlipCount

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileFlipCount:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of the Flip, or 0 before the first measured frame and without `--profile`.

## Description

Tells which Flip ended the last measured frame, counted from the start of the program. It is the number that the lines of [ProfileSlow](ProfileSlow) show, and it changes with every [Flip](Flip), which is how a program notices that new numbers are there for [ProfileValue](ProfileValue).

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
Flip
Print ProfileFlipCount()
```
